data.exact_reserve_text: The result for the 2019 year of account closed on 31 December 2021 with a comprehensive loss of GBP 8.6m on gross premiums written of GBP 203.0m. This was, on the whole, due to some deterioration in the Contingency account's COVID-19 claims, as changing lockdown restrictions caused some rescheduled events to be rescheduled again or even finally cancelled where further rescheduling was no longer practical.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior year strengthening of GBP 8.560 million, representing 4.74% of opening gross reserves. This adverse development was primarily driven by a deterioration in the Contingency account's COVID-19 claims for the 2019 underwriting year, which closed with a comprehensive loss. The deterioration was attributed to changing lockdown restrictions causing rescheduled events to be cancelled or rescheduled again.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly stated and the claims development triangles are distorted by Reinsurance to Close (RITC) for 2019 and prior years. The 'Contingency' line of business for LOB movements has been mapped to 'Aggregate' as it is not a standard Lloyd's LOB.
